keyEvents.text: Axel Disasi (Crystal Palace) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
First Half ends, Crystal Palace 0, Real Sociedad 0.
Second Half begins Crystal Palace 0, Real Sociedad 0.
Delay in match because of an injury Jon Martín (Real Sociedad).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Crystal Palace. Dwight McNeil replaces Eddie Nketiah.
Jon Martín (Real Sociedad) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Crystal Palace 0, Real Sociedad 1. Mamadou Sarr (Real Sociedad) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Job Ochieng.
Substitution, Real Sociedad. Carlos Soler replaces Beñat Turrientes.
Substitution, Real Sociedad. Orri Óskarsson replaces Gonçalo Guedes.
Second yellow card to Jon Martín (Real Sociedad) for a bad foul.
Unai Marrero (Real Sociedad) is shown the yellow card.
Goal! Crystal Palace 1, Real Sociedad 1. Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) converts the penalty with a right footed shot to the centre of the goal.
Yéremy Pino (Crystal Palace) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) is shown the yellow card.
Substitution, Real Sociedad. Igor Zubeldia replaces Héctor Fort.
Substitution, Real Sociedad. Sergio Gómez replaces Arsen Zakharyan.
Substitution, Crystal Palace. Anan Khalaili replaces Jaydee Canvot.
Substitution, Crystal Palace. Tyrick Mitchell replaces Ben Chilwell.
Substitution, Crystal Palace. Jørgen Strand Larsen replaces Will Hughes.
Goal! Crystal Palace 2, Real Sociedad 1. Dwight McNeil (Crystal Palace) left footed shot from very close range to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Jørgen Strand Larsen.
Substitution, Real Sociedad. Luka Sucic replaces Job Ochieng.
Substitution, Crystal Palace. Darío Osorio replaces Jean-Philippe Mateta.
Carlos Soler (Real Sociedad) is shown the yellow card for handball.
Penalty saved. Yéremy Pino (Crystal Palace) right footed shot saved in the bottom left corner by Unai Marrero (Real Sociedad).
Second Half ends, Crystal Palace 2, Real Sociedad 1.
